title: 第二十一章 破虚真燚第二十二章 手段尽出
lines: “怎么？！冥道友想让在下陨落于此不成？！”
雷涅眼神漠然的盯着远处高空中的冥陆老怪，言语听闻，似是轻飘随意，可其内蕴藏着的，却是将要如洪水决堤般的暴怒，以及已是泄露而出的丝许杀意！
“哈哈哈哈……到不至如此，只要你在我接下来的一击下，能够被轰成重伤，此行于我而言”
“便不算白来！”
冥陆老怪在听得雷涅那，满含暴怒的森冷言语，却是讥讽一笑，随即淡然说道。
但若是仔细观察冥陆老怪展露而出的神情，其看似面无表情的面庞，于此刻的眼瞳中凝汇出一抹隐匿极深的凝重之色！
想来先前雷涅与邪灵门长老的一番大战，还是在其心中，留下了少许对雷涅的正重之意。
但也仅是少许而已……
这邪灵门的长老之所以会拼尽全力与雷涅争斗，最主要的一点还是源自于这冥陆老怪在其中作梗。
“魔渊门”、“邪灵门”，光听名字便能猜到两者间颇有渊源！
而事实也正是如此，这邪灵门早年是魔渊门的一个附属势力，只因其门内坐镇老祖，踏入至半步灭境的层次，才从魔渊门独立而出，并入六派的行列中。
但其却还是与魔渊门保持极其深渊的联系，而也就是因此间还算和睦的关系。
这邪灵门的长老才在冥陆重金许诺，与权衡利弊之下，答应冥陆老怪在争斗中用自身最强之力，重创雷涅的请求。
可没曾想，自己竟会阴沟里翻船，反被雷涅重创败落！
虽然此之一战对这邪灵门长老来说，可谓损失惨重。
但对即将应战雷涅的冥陆老怪而言，却算的上，对雷涅战力一次不错的削弱，并让其对雷涅的实力有了更为深刻的认识。
原本这冥陆老怪想着，让这雷涅在自己应战其之前的七场战斗中，多消耗一些自身玄气。
也好借此机会，彻底观察一下这雷涅实力的深浅。
但令其颇感无语的是，除了最后与雷涅争斗的邪灵门长老外，其余六人只不过是行了一些表面攻势，便都匆匆败下阵来。
这之中，尤其要属那化圣门的灵青圣老道，敷衍的最为过火。
其在众目睽睽之下，尽然只是往雷涅身上拍了一掌，便胡乱编了个借口，闪飞遁离而走。
此般举动不仅让那冥陆老怪眼角挑动，嘴角抽搐，几欲要直接冲到其面前，与这老而无脸的灵老头决一生死。
更是让令一名当事者——雷涅，也是满脸震惊错愕，有些哭笑不得！
不过雷涅随即想到，自己在与这灵老头的多次言谈中，已是甚为知晓，其人到底如何行事。
此般做态，于其那绝不吃丝毫亏的性格来说，到也在情理之中！
雷涅最终也是苦笑摇头，释然而开……
所以唯有一场，还算过得上眼的争斗，被冥陆老怪拿来参照。
使其对雷涅的实力衡量，也只能达到眼下这般程度了。
不过即便如此，他也能颇敢断定，以雷涅的实力决然不会接下，他的全力一击！
“莫要说这雷涅以现在所展露的实力，去硬撼自己在全力施展下，催发而起的攻势。”
“就算将其实力再翻上，此间十倍不止，其也必然会在自己的攻势下，被重创！”
“说不定还真有陨落的可能！”
想到此一点的冥陆老怪，嘴角流露出一抹，讥讽与森然并杂在一起的诡异弧度。
content_en:
"What?! Fellow Taoist Ming wants me to perish here?!"
Rene's eyes were indifferently staring at the old monster from the Underworld in the sky in the distance. His words seemed light and casual, but what they contained was a rage that was about to burst like a flood, and a hint of murderous intent that had already leaked out!
"Hahahaha... That's not the case. As long as you can be seriously injured by my next blow, this trip is for me."
"It's not in vain!"
The old monster from the Underworld smiled sarcastically when he heard Reinena's cold words filled with rage, and then said calmly.
But if you carefully observe the expression of the old monster from the Underworld, his seemingly expressionless face condenses into a deep and solemn look in his eyes at this moment!
Thinking about the previous battle between Reine and the elders of the Evil Spirit Sect, it still left a little sense of respect for Reine in his heart.
But only a little...
The main reason why the elder of the Evil Spirit Sect tried his best to fight against Rene was because the old monster from the Underworld was causing trouble.
"Demon Abyss Gate" and "Evil Spirit Gate", just by listening to the names, you can guess that there is a connection between the two!
And the fact is exactly the same. In the early years, the Evil Spirit Sect was an affiliated force of the Moyuan Sect. Only because the ancestor in the sect reached the level of half-step annihilation, it became independent from the Moyuan Sect and merged into the ranks of the six sects.
But it still maintains an extremely abyssal connection with the Moyuan Sect, and that is why the relationship was relatively harmonious during this period.
The elder of the Evil Spirit Sect only agreed to the old monster from Minglu's request to use his strongest power to severely injure Reine in the battle after Minglu's huge financial promise and weighing the pros and cons.
But I never thought that I would capsize in the gutter and be severely injured and defeated by Rene!
Although this battle was a heavy loss for the elder of the Evil Spirit Sect.
But for the old monster from the Underworld who was about to challenge Reine, it was considered a good thing. It weakened Reine's combat power well and gave him a deeper understanding of Reine's strength.
Originally, the old monster from the underworld wanted to let Rene consume more of his own profound energy in the seven battles before he challenged him.
It would be a good idea to take this opportunity to thoroughly observe the depth of Reine's strength.
But what made him quite speechless was that, except for the elder of the Evil Spirit Sect who finally fought with Reine, the other six people only carried out some superficial offensives and were hurriedly defeated.
Among them, especially the Lingqing Saint of the Huasheng Sect, he was the most perfunctory.
In full view of everyone, he just slapped Rene on the body, made up a random excuse, and fled away in a flash.
This move not only made the corners of the eyes of the old monster from the underworld twitch, but also made the corners of his mouth twitch. He almost wanted to rush directly in front of him and fight to the death with this old and faceless old man Ling.
What's more, one of the people involved, Rene, was also shocked and stunned, and somewhat dumbfounded!
However, Rene immediately thought that through many conversations with this old man, he already knew very well how he behaved.
Such behavior is quite reasonable considering his character who never suffers any loss!
In the end, Rene smiled bitterly and shook his head in relief...
So there was only one fight that was pretty good, and the old monster from the Underworld used it as a reference.
Its ability to measure Rene's strength can only reach the current level.
But even so, he was quite confident that with Rene's strength, he would definitely not take his full blow!
"Don't let it be said that Rene, with the strength he has shown now, can withstand the offensive launched by him with all his strength."
"Even if its strength is increased tenfold, it will definitely be severely damaged by my own attack!"
"Maybe there is a real possibility of death!"
Thinking of this, the old monster from Minglu revealed a strange arc that blended sarcasm and seriousness at the corner of his mouth.
